formalization_notes: 9 family identities selected across three issuer periods; 10 variant drafts. The two USSR order photo rows are family-level image references with specific model/award record unresolved; they are not strict normalized variants yet.
8 variant rows have an evidenced grade/design label; 2 rows are marked unspecified family-image references and excluded from strict variant-count until review.
All selected image files decode and show the entire award body. Russo-Japanese front/reverse, and Soviet For Courage front/reverse, are not asserted to depict the same specimen.
Official diagrams are explicitly labeled as diagrams. No search-engine preview or synthetic image is used.
